dialogue.english: Hello! Welcome to my magic world.
dialogue.twFullText: 你好！歡迎來到魔法世界。

cards.english: A nine-colored deer lives by a magic river.
Its white antlers shine like snow.

dialogue.english: My coat shines with nine colors!
The clear river is full of lotus flowers.

cards.english: A little crow is its best friend.
They sing and play among glowing flowers.

dialogue.english: The forest flowers smell so sweet!

cards.english: One day, a man falls into the wild river.
He cries out loudly for help!
The kind deer leaps into the waves.
It carries the man safely to shore.

dialogue.english: Hold on tight! We are almost safe!
You are so brave and kind!

cards.english: The man kneels and makes a promise.
“Thank you! I will keep your secret.”

dialogue.english: I promise never to tell anyone!

cards.english: The queen dreams of the glowing deer.
She offers gold to find it.

dialogue.english: I want that glowing nine-colored deer!
Whoever finds the deer will receive gold!

cards.english: The greedy man breaks his promise.
The little crow flies fast to warn the deer!

dialogue.english: Wake up! The king's army is coming!
Look! The nine-colored deer is right there!

cards.english: The deer tells the king the whole truth.
The king protects it. Kindness wins!

dialogue.english: I saved his life, yet he broke his word.
dialogue.twFullText: 我救了他，他卻背叛了我。

dialogue.english: No one shall ever harm this kind deer!
dialogue.twFullText: 從今以後，永遠保護九色鹿！
